usedFor: Whautomate holds client appointments, and Google Calendar shows them when “New Appointment Scheduled” runs “Create Calendar Event”.

bestTemplate.name: “New Appointment Scheduled” in Whautomate, then “Create Calendar Event” in Google Calendar
bestTemplate.why: Every appointment booked lands on your calendar with time, duration and attendees.

watchOut: “New Event” in Google Calendar is polling, so “Create Client” in Whautomate follows a scheduled check.
